new_scholarship.description: Study in Finland, the official guide operated by the Finnish National Agency for Education, states that all scholarships and tuition fee waivers in Finland are awarded by individual universities and that no governmental scholarship programmes exist. Where a university offers a scholarship it is competitive and normally covers tuition fees only, partially or in full; the student must independently cover living costs. Applications are made through the university's own admissions process, either together with the admission application or after studies have started. Applicants are directed to Studyinfo.fi and to the universities' own websites for the actual schemes and deadlines.

research_notes.logo: UCPH's scholarship page renders no standalone logo file in the markdown view, so I probed the university's own domain: https://www.ku.dk/favicon.ico returned HTTP 200 with image/x-icon, confirming an image content type, and it is UCPH's own site mark, so it is reported with image_format ico. I deliberately did not report the stored image, whose own filename (csm_Tuition_fees_and_scholarships_NEGATIV_...) identifies it as the negative/white variant of a wordmark, which would be white-on-transparent and banned.

research_notes.degree_level_confirmed: Quoted: eligibility requires being 'admitted to a master's degree programme at the University of Copenhagen', and all section headings and conditions refer to MA/MSc applicants. The page does not offer this scholarship at bachelor's level.
contradictions: Stored program_type was a scraped fragment of the Fulbright section ('Head to the different master's degrees programmes and read the specific requirements here'), which describes how to apply for a Fulbright master's place, not this scholarship. Removed.

Stored deadline_display 'With admission application' implies an application; the official page says the opposite - 'you do not submit an individual application for the scholarship' - and adds an acceptance deadline after nomination, with the offer revoked if missed.
Stored image was a white/negative variant wordmark (filename contains NEGATIV), a banned white-on-transparent asset; replaced with a verified UCPH domain logo.

Stored funding 'Partial' understates the range: UCPH states the award is a full or partial tuition waiver and/or a basic living-expense grant, and at the Faculty of Science it covers tuition plus living expenses for 22 months.
